COMPANY

A sovereign minerals trade office at the Berbera gateway.
About Us

Corridorway is a Somaliland-based minerals trade office connecting verified origin to global industrial demand, using the Berbera gateway as its operational base. We work across the Origin, Proof, Movement and Market stages of the trade lifecycle, applying an evidence-led standard to every listing.

Our Approach

Every mineral listing carries an Evidence Passport — origin, authority to sell, assay, specification, compliance and logistics status — before it reaches a buyer. We do not publish a claim we cannot support, and we mark anything unverified as such rather than omit or overstate it.

Governance

Corridorway operates under Somaliland trade regulations and maintains chain-of-custody documentation across the Origin → Proof → Movement → Market lifecycle. Partner, certification and reserve claims are published only where verified and approved.

Contact

Corridorway Minerals Trade Office, Berbera, Somaliland. For trade inquiries, contact info@corridorway.com or +252 63 448 0044.
